def_en: 1) to excel, be bright, be preeminent, be perpetual, be overseer, be enduring
1b) (Piel) to act as overseer or superintendent or director or chief
kjv: excel, chief musician (singer), oversee(-r), set forward.
expl: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
etim: a primitive root; also as denominative from
